test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

‘M & N’ means ‘M is the mother of N’

‘M @ N’ means ‘M is the son of N’,

‘M # N’ means ‘M is the daughter of N’.

Based on the above, how is L related to O if ‘K & L & M # N @ O’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 &
 @
 #
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Son
 Daughter 
 
 

 

Given: K & L & M # N @ O

It means: K is the mother of L, L is the mother of M, M is the daughter of N and N is the son of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7b567307e942ca8fd926648222da5d11585354a2b0b808a5dc2945cacc8a4aa.png] 

So, L is the '**Son’s wife​' **of O.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
